caption: The drawing features an abstract geometric figure positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The main form is a vertically oriented shape resembling a stylized tower or robe, colored in shades of muted gold and brown with subtle greenish undertones, divided by visible vertical and horizontal lines into rectangular segments. At the top of this shape, there are two symmetrical, oval loop shapes side by side, also in brown, with a narrow space between them and open centers. Below these loops, there are two smaller curved projections flaring outward, followed by a narrow stem connecting this upper part to the central vertical shape. Extending horizontally from the middle of the vertical form is a thin, straight, dark brown rod terminating in a large, brownish circular sphere on the right side, shaded to suggest volume. The composition is sparse, and no additional objects or adornments are visible against the background.
title: Weather Vane
